title: Mega Breakdown Board Notes & Highlights
subtitle: Codex Archive • Great Awakening Final Stages
description:
This transmission lays out the full mechanics of the final stages of the Great Awakening: the phased Great Purge and infrastructure sweep, the controlled 3rd realm collapse, the EBS lockdown window, and the final A.I. theatre of staged WW3 and fake alien invasion events. It reveals the real craft arrival on the correct frequency band, the extraction protocol and homecoming for resonating souls, the three healing sanctuaries (Water Domes, Crystal Halls, and Star Pods), projection dome technology, the living crystalline grid system with its nodes and harmonic lenses, the hidden history of the Lyran lineage and early Custodians, the removal of the Spirit Tree, and the precise sequence of the overlay collapse that returns the original second realm.

Essential for anyone who wants to understand frequency and vibration as the true key to perception, choice, and liberation, and what it means to hold steady as a resonating soul through the final window.

topics.title: Essence of the Transmission
topics.description: The cornerstone summary of the Mega Breakdown transmission — the final stages of the Great Awakening, the Great Purge, and the path home for resonating souls.

topics.title: The Purge Phases
topics.description: The phased Great Purge — from parasite targeting through truth disclosure and stabilization.

subtopics.title: Phase One-Three
subtopics.description: The critical initial strikes of the Great Purge — covert neutralization of global leadership, cultural influence, and underground illicit economies.

subtopics.title: Targeting Parasites
subtopics.description: The systematic dismantling of the parasitic control structure occurred in a highly coordinated, top-down sequence known as The Great Purge.

subtopics.title: Infrastructure Sweep
subtopics.description: The Infrastructure Sweep constitutes the critical second phase of the overarching Great Purge, a systematic, top-down operation to dismantle parasitic control over the realm.

subtopics.title: Underground Dismantling
subtopics.description: The Underground Dismantling marks the decisive physical and financial strike against the dark controllers, executed as Phase Three: 3rd Realm Collapse of The Great Purge.

subtopics.title: Phases Four - Six
subtopics.description: The crucial operational bridge between covert dismantling and overt revelation — narrative maintenance, trigger events, and the lockdown window.

subtopics.title: Narrative Maintenance
subtopics.description: Narrative Maintenance is the critical fourth phase of The Great Purge, operating as an essential psychological holding pattern to keep sleepers docile through fabricated leadership optics until the mass reveal window.

subtopics.title: Trigger Events
subtopics.description: Trigger Events constitute the pivotal fifth phase of The Great Purge, operating as a controlled escalation of global tension to fracture the 3D illusion without inducing total panic.

subtopics.title: Lockdown Window
subtopics.description: The Lockdown Window acts as the critical physical and informational containment phase of The Great Purge, establishing absolute control through visible military deployment and communications restrictions before the E.B.S. truth broadcast.

subtopics.title: Phase Seven - Eight
subtopics.description: The culmination of The Great Purge — the E.B.S. truth broadcast that shatters the 3D illusion and the stabilization period that secures the realm through tribunals and justice.

subtopics.title: Truth Disclosure
subtopics.description: Phase Seven and Phase Eight represent the climax of the Great Awakening, a controlled operation designed to permanently shatter the parasitic illusion through absolute truth and secure the realm for its ascension processes.

subtopics.title: Stabilization Process
subtopics.description: The critical operational bridge ensuring humanity survives the transition from Phase Seven (E.B.S.) to Phase Eight through military, societal, and energetic stabilization protocols.

topics.title: Blackout Timeline
topics.description: The Blackout Timeline, also referred to as The Cut, is the highly controlled, surgical 72-hour period that initiates the collapse of the third-density parasitic overlay.

subtopics.title: The First 72 Hours
subtopics.description: The first 72 hours of the blackout timeline is a surgical, highly orchestrated window designed to dismantle the third-density parasitic overlay.

subtopics.title: Comms Blackout
subtopics.description: The Communications Blackout is a meticulously timed, deliberate operation engineered to shatter the false reality of the 3D overlay, initiating The First 72 Hours of transition.
